title: SARIMAX forecast
code:
from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX

model = SARIMAX(
    endog=df['value'],
    order=(1, 1, 1),
    seasonal_order=(1, 1, 1, 12),
    enforce_stationarity=False,
)
results = model.fit(disp=False)
pred = results.forecast(steps=12)
print(pred)

title: Auto-ARIMA (pmdarima)
code:
from pmdarima import auto_arima

model = auto_arima(
    df['value'],
    seasonal=True, m=12,
    stepwise=True, trace=True,
)
print(model.summary())
pred = model.predict(n_periods=6)
note: Tự động chọn p, d, q tốt nhất

title: Polars lazy scan parquet
code:
import polars as pl

df = (
    pl.scan_parquet('data/*.parquet')
    .filter(pl.col('date') >= '2025-01-01')
    .group_by('category')
    .agg(pl.col('value').sum().alias('total'))
    .sort('total', descending=True)
    .collect()
)
print(df)
note: Lazy evaluation — chỉ load data cần thiết

title: Window: running total
code:
SELECT
    date,
    category,
    value,
    SUM(value) OVER (
        PARTITION BY category
        ORDER BY date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_total
FROM fact_table
ORDER BY category, date;
note: Cumulative sum per category theo ngày

title: CTE + recursive hierarchy
code:
WITH RECURSIVE hier AS (
    SELECT id, name, parent_id, 0 AS level
    FROM org_table
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id, h.level + 1
    FROM org_table c
    JOIN hier h ON c.parent_id = h.id
)
SELECT * FROM hier ORDER BY level, name;
note: Duyệt cây hierarchy với recursive CTE

title: Dynamic pivot (CASE WHEN)
code:
SELECT
    date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'A' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS cat_a,
    SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'B' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS cat_b,
    SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'C' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS cat_c
FROM fact_table
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
note: Manual pivot khi DB không có PIVOT function

title: Lag/Lead: month-over-month
code:
SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue,1) OVER (ORDER BY month))
        / NULLIF(LAG(revenue,1) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2
    ) AS mom_pct
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;
